entries.alpha_decision: Measured source and returned alpha extrema are [0,255] and [0,254]. Internal backing, clothing and note paper show no visible holes or working-matte halo, and internal 252-254 values are not rejection grounds. The native alpha is not source-compatible at the note exterior: the two large right-edge notches make transparent incursions where the source note remains intact. Because the RGB note contour is also wrong, this is not approved for an alpha-only repair. No source-alpha repair was performed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact cheek sideburn/beard boundary, fine glasses-rim hardware and note glyphs are not fully resolvable. Those limits are not rejection grounds.
